text: DSH Update Guard 是面向 DSH 桌面端的更新兼容性检查插件。它在更新下载后扫描待安装版本的接口，并与已安装插件使用的接口和版本声明比对；检查结果可在设置面板查看。用户可以选择自动禁用检测到不兼容的插件条目，也可用命令行检查、锁定或撤销锁定。它还提供配置恢复和可选的启动器修复能力，适合希望在升级 DSH 前了解插件兼容情况并恢复插件配置的桌面端用户。需要在本机使用 DSH 配置目录和待安装更新。

DSH Update Guard checks downloaded DSH updates against installed plugins and reports compatibility findings. Users can review results in a settings panel, optionally disable affected entries, and undo those changes. It also restores plugin configuration and offers optional desktop launcher repair.
想在安装 DSH 桌面更新前知道哪些已装插件可能不兼容。
DSH 更新后插件配置被清空了，怎样从备份恢复？
能不能只禁用这次更新会出问题的插件，并且之后撤销？
我想在 DSH 设置页查看更新兼容检查结果并调整自动处理选项。
Can I check whether installed plugins match a downloaded DSH update before installing it?
I need to restore my DSH plugin configuration from a backup after it was reset.
更新前兼容性检查：下载更新后，插件比较待安装版本的客户端接口和已安装插件的使用情况，并记录检查报告。启动后可自动运行，也能通过命令行检查。
选择性锁定插件：检查发现不兼容条目后，可选择自动处理或从命令行锁定；锁定记录支持撤销。
配置恢复与设置面板：宿主 webServer 路由提供配置读写和报告读取，浏览器面板展示检查摘要并调整可写选项。
更新后插件突然不能启动，我想知道是不是新版本移除了它用到的接口。
How can I undo plugin disables after checking a DSH update?

dsh-update-guard README · 起因：一次更新，连崩四次：2026-11-05，升级到 `0.2.2-rc.1` 之后，DSH 起不来了。没有界面，没有提示，只有日志里这一句：

```
DesktopHostFatalError: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open
  'D:\deep\resources\runtime\office-skills\office\SKILL.md'
    at readFileSync (node:fs:483:20)
    at @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-office/lib/index.js:64:38

更新器清空了 `resources\runtime`。`dsh-skill-office` 启动时必须读里面的 `SKILL.md`，读不到就在 Fiber 里抛错，**整个 host 启动失败**。而 runtime 不在 `app.asar` 内，磁盘上没有别处能补 —— 只能重装。

四份 crash log 是同一分钟内连崩四次留下的。

这个插件就是为了让这件事不再发生。
section: 起因：一次更新，连崩四次

text:
dsh-update-guard README · 装与不装：|  | 不装 | 装了 |
|---|---|---|
| 更新前 | 不知道哪些插件会断 | 列出会失效的插件和具体成员 |
| 更新后崩了 | 重装 DSH | 启动器自动从安装包恢复 runtime，10 秒 |
| 配置被重置 | 插件全没 | 从备份外科式还原，只跳过坏的那个 |
| 图标被改回 | 自愈能力一起没了 | 下次启动自动改回来 |

dsh-update-guard README · 一、更新前检查：应用下载完更新、还没安装时：从安装包里解出两套接口面，扫描已装插件实际用到什么，**只报告用到了新版本里没有的东西的插件**。

| 证据 | 缺失后果 | 自动锁定 |
|---|---|---|
| 客户端成员（`UiPrimitives.xxx`） | 渲染抛错，界面崩 | ✅ 会锁 |
| 宿主服务（`inject: [...]`） | 插件激活不了；required 插件会让整个应用起不来 | ❌ 只提示 |

宿主服务不自动锁：服务可能以扫描器没建模的方式动态提供，误判会锁掉正常插件。报出来，你自己判断。

**解析不出来就说解析不出来**，不当成"接口全缺"：模块表解析失败时该项标记为 `unverified` 并写进 `surfaceUnverifiedModules`，**不触发自动锁定**。

没有解压器也不失败，降级成「只比版本声明」（`engines.dsh` / `peerDependencies`），这本来就是加载器自己的检查。部分检查**不会**显示成"没有发现不兼容"。

dsh-update-guard README · 二、崩了能修：桌面上挂一个启动包装器（`wscript` + 隐藏窗口，没有控制台黑框）：

- **runtime 被清空** → 从 `pending` 里的安装包解回来（实测 10.2 秒、6144 个文件），失败则明确阻止启动并提示修复
- 启动失败 → 重试 → 仍然失败就弹框问你（默认按钮是「否」）
- 插件配置被清空 → 从备份还原，只跳过有问题的那个
- 快捷方式被改回直连 exe → 下次启动自动改回
- 同一时刻只允许一个启动器

dsh-update-guard README · 实测，不是理论上：```
runtime 恢复        10.2 秒，6144 个文件，SKILL.md 回来
解包读取            5.2 秒，951,974 字符的 shell bundle
缓存复用            同包第二次不重解（asar mtime 不变）
测试                27/27 通过，47 秒，0 跳过

dsh-update-guard README · 安装：需要 Node.js 18+、Windows、DSH 桌面端。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiuyuan-yi/dsh-update-guard
```

首次运行会要求 `allowBuilds` 批准，按提示加上再跑一次。装完重启。

市场页：https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/jiuyuan-yi/dsh-update-guard/

dsh-update-guard README · 命令行：```bash
node bin/guard.mjs check            # 检查待安装的更新
node bin/guard.mjs check --json     # 机器可读
node bin/guard.mjs lock             # 锁定命中的插件
node bin/guard.mjs unlock           # 撤销锁定

退出码：`0` 正常，`2` 发现不兼容，`1` 出错。

dsh-update-guard README · 配置：`<profile>/.dsh-update-guard.json`

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `preflightOnStartup` | `true` | 启动时跑检查 |
| `autoLock` | `false` | 命中直接锁定，不询问 |
| `maxAutoLock` | `3` | 一次最多锁几个 |
| `autoRestore` | `true` | 配置被清空时从备份还原 |
| `installLauncher` | `false` | 是否接管桌面快捷方式 |

dsh-update-guard README · 它不会做什么：- 不联网，不上报任何数据
- 不改插件代码，只改 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `disabled` 字段，逐字节可还原
- 不碰 `!!js` 这类条件值（加载器的动态表达式，改写会破坏语义）
- 不判断自己
- 不写死绝对路径：安装目录从注册表 `InstallLocation` 问

dsh-update-guard README · 已知限制：- **只在 Windows 验证过**（启动包装器依赖 `wscript.exe`）
- 接口面比对只看 4 个共享 UI 模块 + 宿主服务名，宿主侧 API 的**行为变化**（签名、语义）不在覆盖范围
- 只在 `0.2.1-rc.5 → 0.2.2-rc.1` 这一次真实升级上验证过，更早的版本对没有样本
- 还原时的插件校验只做结构检查，**不启动插件验证运行时行为**
- runtime 自愈依赖 `pending` 里还留着安装包；装完手动删掉就补不回来
- runtime 完整性用「四个子树 + versions.json + 文件数」判定，不是逐文件清单

dsh-update-guard README · 如果你也遇到了：这个插件最大的短板是**只经历过一次真实升级**。如果你在某个版本对上遇到下面任一情况，开个 issue 说一声，把版本号和现象带上就行：

- 更新后 DSH 起不来，日志里有 `ENOENT` 或 `is not a function`
- 更新前检查说某个插件会断，但你装完发现它其实没事（**这更重要** —— 误报会让人不敢用）
- 启动器把 runtime 判定成不完整，可你觉得 runtime 是好的（用 `DSH_LAUNCHER_FORCE_START=1` 能启动的那种）

前两种帮我补版本样本，最后一种帮我修判据。都不需要你改代码。

```
DesktopHostFatalError: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open
  'D:\deep\resources\runtime\office-skills\office\SKILL.md'
    at readFileSync (node:fs:483:20)
    at @deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-office/lib/index.js:64:38
section: Why this exists: one update, four crashes in a row

text:
dsh-update-guard README · Why this exists: one update, four crashes in a row：The updater had emptied `resources\runtime`. `dsh-skill-office` reads `SKILL.md` from there at startup; a missing file throws inside a Fiber and **the whole host fails to boot**. And runtime is not inside `app.asar`, so there was nothing on disk to restore from — reinstalling was the only way out.

Four crash logs, all within the same minute.

This plugin exists so that does not happen again.
section: Why this exists: one update, four crashes in a row

text:
dsh-update-guard README · With and without：|  | Without | With |
|---|---|---|
| Before updating | No idea which plugins will break | Lists the plugins and the exact members |
| After it breaks | Reinstall DSH | Launcher restores runtime from the installer, ~10s |
| Config reset | Plugins gone | Surgical restore, skipping only the broken one |
| Icon reverted | The healing is gone too | Re-pointed on next launch |

dsh-update-guard README · 1. Pre-update compatibility check：Once the app has downloaded an update but not installed it: extract two interface surfaces from the installer, scan what the installed plugins actually use, and **report only the ones that reference something the new version no longer exposes**.

| Evidence | If missing | Auto-lock |
|---|---|---|
| Client members (`UiPrimitives.xxx`) | Render throws, UI dies | ✅ locked |
| Host services (`inject: [...]`) | Plugin cannot activate; a required one takes the whole app down | ❌ reported only |

dsh-update-guard README · 1. Pre-update compatibility check：Host services are never auto-locked: a service may be provided dynamically in ways the scanner does not model, and a false positive would disable a healthy plugin. It is reported; you decide.

**"Cannot parse" is never reported as "everything is missing":** when a module table fails to parse, the entry is marked `unverified` and listed under `surfaceUnverifiedModules`, and it **does not trigger auto-lock**.

dsh-update-guard README · 1. Pre-update compatibility check：No extractor is not a failure: it degrades to comparing version declarations only (`engines.dsh` / `peerDependencies`), which is what the loader checks anyway. A partial check is never displayed as "nothing incompatible found".

dsh-update-guard README · 2. Recovery：A launcher shim on the desktop (`wscript` + hidden window, no console flash):

- **runtime emptied** → extracted back from the installer in `pending` (measured: 10.2s, 6144 files); if that fails, startup is refused with a clear message instead of looping
- Start fails → retry → still failing, asks you (default button is "no")
- Plugin config wiped → restored from backup, skipping only the broken entry
- Shortcut reverted to the exe → re-pointed on next launch
- Only one launcher at a time

dsh-update-guard README · Measured, not assumed：```
runtime restore     10.2s, 6144 files, SKILL.md back
extraction + read   5.2s, 951,974 characters of shell bundle
cache reuse         second run on the same package does not re-extract (asar mtime unchanged)
tests               27/27 pass, 47s, 0 skipped

dsh-update-guard README · Install：Node.js 18+, Windows, DSH desktop.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiuyuan-yi/dsh-update-guard
```

The first run asks you to approve `allowBuilds` — follow the hint and retry. Then restart.

Marketplace page: https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/jiuyuan-yi/dsh-update-guard/

dsh-update-guard README · CLI：```bash
node bin/guard.mjs check            # check the pending update
node bin/guard.mjs check --json     # machine readable
node bin/guard.mjs lock             # lock the plugins that will break
node bin/guard.mjs unlock           # undo

Exit codes: `0` ok, `2` incompatible plugins found, `1` error.

dsh-update-guard README · Config：`<profile>/.dsh-update-guard.json`

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `preflightOnStartup` | `true` | check at startup |
| `autoLock` | `false` | lock hits without asking |
| `maxAutoLock` | `3` | how many to lock at once |
| `autoRestore` | `true` | restore config from backup when wiped |
| `installLauncher` | `false` | take over the desktop shortcut |

dsh-update-guard README · What it will not do：- No network access, no telemetry
- Does not touch plugin code; only flips `disabled` in `cordis.patch.yml`, byte-for-byte reversible
- Does not rewrite `!!js` conditional values (loader expressions; rewriting breaks semantics)
- Does not judge itself
- No hardcoded absolute paths: the install root comes from the registry `InstallLocation`

dsh-update-guard README · Known limits：- **Windows only, verified only there** (the launcher depends on `wscript.exe`)
- Interface comparison covers 4 shared UI modules plus host service names — host API **behaviour** changes (signatures, semantics) are out of scope
- Verified against exactly one real upgrade (`0.2.1-rc.5 → 0.2.2-rc.1`); earlier version pairs have no sample
- Restore validates plugins structurally only; it does not start them to check runtime behaviour
- runtime healing needs the installer still present in `pending`; delete it and there is nothing to restore from
- runtime completeness is judged by four subtrees + `versions.json` + a file count, not a per-file manifest
